# Fintech Spec Section

Write the regulatory, risk and compliance section of a PRD, BRD or feature spec for a money-moving or financial product: map which obligations the feature triggers (KYC and customer due diligence, AML monitoring and suspicious activity reporting, sanctions screening, PCI DSS scope, consumer disclosures, record keeping, privacy), write the requirements with their control owners, audit events and failure and exception paths, tabulate the personal and financial data involved, and list the open questions for compliance, legal and the bank or sponsor partner. A review draft for the compliance team to confirm — not legal advice, and no threshold, deadline or legal conclusion is stated as settled.
